title: Match equivalent Git directory spellings consistently in origin custody checks
outcome: Equivalent repository directory spellings do not cause false origin quarantine while actual directory/scope mismatches still refuse.
acceptance: Origin custody and captured-root deduplication use the same checked directory equivalence as the E1 owner without filesystem I/O newly added inside SQL writer.
A Windows regression with a differently spelled successor binding preserves known custody and successful exchange; different directories remain isolated.
